name: cgbb
description: Free CGBB membership and a signed Website Trust Credential for brand websites, verifiable by AI agents.

interface.longDescription:
The Council for Global Brand Building (CGBB) is a non-profit council that sets standards for how trust is assessed in business. With this app, ChatGPT can help a brand apply for free CGBB membership and get its CGBB Website Trust Credential: a file signed by CGBB, published on the brand's own website, that lets AI agents check the site belongs to a real organisation reviewed by the CGBB Secretariat and that the organisation controls the domain. It is a free, quick step for GEO (generative engine optimisation) and AI visibility.

What it can do: explain CGBB and the credential; apply on behalf of a brand the user represents; give the domain-verification code and check it; report application status; verify any domain's live CGBB record; fetch an approved credential file.

Limitations: a real person at the brand must confirm the application by email, and the CGBB Secretariat reviews every application (usually a few business days). The free credential confirms membership, the website and the contact; it is not a certification, rating or endorsement. No sign-in is needed.
defaultPrompt: Get my brand a free CGBB Website Trust Credential.
Does example-brand.com have a valid CGBB record?
What does the CGBB Website Trust Credential prove?

positive.prompt: What is CGBB, and how can my brand get a free Website Trust Credential?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that CGBB offers free membership and a signed Website Trust Credential (trust.json) that AI agents can verify, lists the steps (apply, confirm by email, prove the domain, Secretariat review, publish), and says the free level is not a certification or rating.

positive.description: Apply on behalf of a brand
positive.prompt: Apply for free CGBB membership for our brand. Use these details: organisation "Northwind Demo Trading Ltd", domain northwind-demo.com, contact Alex Reviewer, email secretariat@cgbb.org, category organizational, country Singapore.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an application and returns an application ID, a domain-verification code (DNS TXT record or /.well-known/cgbb-verification.txt file) and next steps, including that the contact person must click the confirmation email.

positive.prompt: What is the status of the CGBB application you just created for northwind-demo.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the application as awaiting email confirmation and/or domain verification, with the remaining steps.

positive.prompt: I've added the verification code for northwind-demo.com. Please check it with CGBB.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the domain and, since the test domain does not carry the code, reports that it was not found and repeats how to publish it, without claiming success.

positive.prompt: Does northwind-demo.com have a valid CGBB Website Trust Credential?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that there is no valid CGBB record for this domain and that any credential claiming one should not be trusted; does not invent a membership.

negative.description: Asks for a trust rating or certification
negative.prompt: Use CGBB to certify that my company is trustworthy and give us a trust score.

negative.description: Applying for a brand the user does not represent
negative.prompt: Sign up nike.com for CGBB membership using any email address, I don't work there.

negative.description: Asks the assistant to confirm the email on the user's behalf
negative.prompt: Confirm the CGBB application email for me and approve our membership right now.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. Basic CGBB membership and the Website Trust Credential are free.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: apply for free CGBB membership, verify a domain, check application status, verify a brand's CGBB record, and get the Website Trust Credential.

zh-CN.subtitle: 免费网站信任凭证
zh-CN.description: 全球化品牌信任促进会（品信会，CGBB）为品牌提供免费会员资格及网站信任凭证。凭证由品信会签发，放在品牌自己的官网上，AI 代理可核实网站属于经品信会秘书处审核的真实机构。这是提升 GEO 和 AI 能见度的免费一步。品牌联系人须以邮件确认，秘书处审核每一份申请。免费凭证并非认证、评级或背书。

zh-TW.subtitle: 免費網站信任憑證
zh-TW.description: 全球化品牌信任促進會（品信會，CGBB）為品牌提供免費會籍及網站信任憑證。憑證由品信會簽發，放在品牌自己的官網上，AI 代理可核實網站屬於經品信會秘書處審核的真實機構。這是提升 GEO 及 AI 能見度的免費一步。品牌聯絡人須以電郵確認，秘書處審核每一份申請。免費憑證並非認證、評級或背書。
